# SQLite amalgamation

Version 3.54.1, from the official 2026 amalgamation archive. Only the embedded
library (`sqlite3.c`, `sqlite3.h`) is included; shell/tools are not shipped.

`provenance.json` records the archive URL and SHA-256 hashes used by CMake. The
archive SHA3-256 was checked against https://www.sqlite.org/download.html and
the sqlite3.c SHA3-256 against https://www.sqlite.org/releaselog/3_54_1.html.

See https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html and `licenses/sqlite.txt`.
